ranks: March of the Machine: The Aftermath (MAT, 2023-05-12): whole set (the rest of it)

blocked.name: Feast of the Victorious Dead
blocked.why: "distribute that many +1/+1 counters among any number of creatures you control" as it resolves (untargeted): no distribute-counters effect exists (AUTHORING §15)

blocked.name: Undercity Upheaval
blocked.why: Distributed counters are built for a fixed total; this one's total is the creature cards in your graveyard as it's cast.

blocked.name: The Kenriths' Royal Funeral
blocked.why: "cost {1} less for each card exiled with" it, counting only cards still in exile (ruling): CostReductionAmount has no exiled-with-source count; exile `linked` counts for good even after leaving exile

blocked.name: Urborg Scavengers
blocked.why: "has flying as long as a card exiled with it has flying" (and ten more keywords): no static reads keywords off cards exiled with the source

blocked.name: Niv-Mizzet, Supreme
blocked.why: hexproof from monocolored isn't a keyword, and jump-start (cast from graveyard + discard, then exile) has no vocabulary, granted or printed

blocked.name: Tazri, Stalwart Survivor
blocked.why: no CardFilter clause for "creature cards with activated abilities that aren't mana abilities" (the mill), and the granted mana ability needs "any of this creature's colors" plus "activate only if this creature has another activated ability"

blocked.name: Rebuild the City
blocked.why: ruling: the copies' "as [this land] enters" abilities work; the engine doesn't ask as-enters choices (Cavern of Souls' type, a Thriving land's colour) for a token copy (§15), so those copies enter with nothing chosen

blocked.name: Deification
blocked.why: 'damage would remove all loyalty counters -> all but one' replacement doesn't exist; no 'choose a planeswalker type' as-enters choice or ofChosenType for planeswalker subtypes

blocked.name: Arni Metalbrow
blocked.why: no trigger listens to a creature you control entering attacking (the engine emits 'entered-attacking' but no TriggerSpec reads it); 'attacks' never fires for one put onto the battlefield attacking

blocked.name: Tolarian Contempt
blocked.why: The owner's top-or-bottom choice is built; two creatures of one owner going to the same end are ordered by target slot, not by their owner (the ruling).

blocked.name: Blot Out
blocked.why: 'target opponent exiles a creature or planeswalker they control with the greatest MV' is an exile edict chosen by the opponent; only sacrifice has an edict shape, choose-permanents is the controller's choice

blocked.name: Death-Rattle Oni
blocked.why: '{2} less for each creature that died this turn' counts every player's creatures; CostReductionAmount's turnHistory only reads the caster's own list and has no who

blocked.name: Spark Rupture
blocked.why: a static making each planeswalker with loyalty a creature that loses all abilities with P/T = loyalty counters is listed as not modeled (§15, Gideon)

blocked.name: Aetherspouts
blocked.why: 'For each attacking creature, its owner puts it on…' is untargeted: ownerChooses only works on a target slot. Each owner also has to choose in APNAP order and set the order of their own cards that go to the same end (both rulings).

blocked.name: Clash of Elements
blocked.why: 'If they do, 2 damage': each-player-may's ifDid fires once the owner picks top, even if the card never got there. A commander the owner sends to the command zone instead (903.9b) should take no damage. No this-way or condition checks that a library move actually happened.

blocked.name: Swat Away
blocked.why: "Costs {2} less if a creature is attacking you": no StaticCondition or CardFilter clause for a creature attacking *you* specifically (opponent-controls + attacking also matches creatures attacking another player or your planeswalker/battle). The top-or-bottom half is fine.
